idea-plugin.name: Rider VCX Filters Fix
idea-plugin.description:
Rider VCX Filters Fix is an offline compatibility plugin for large Unreal Engine C++ solutions opened in JetBrains Rider 2026.3.

It combines two cooperating fixes in one package:
  • Solution Explorer frontend: prevents Show All Files from inserting duplicate physical project-directory files beneath virtual VCX filter nodes, while preserving the real model nodes, their order, and project-root files.
  • .NET backend: neutralizes Unreal's forced VCX-filter disabling so the user's Use VCX project filters setting is honored, including turning filters off normally.
Compatibility: JetBrains Rider 2026.3 (branch 263) and later.
Verified build: RD-263.7307.258. Future Rider releases are permitted by the open compatibility range, but should be revalidated because this plugin uses internal Rider APIs.
Maintainer: ChenXin (L66 Tools).
Plugin ID: local.rider.vcx-filter-view-fix.

The plugin does not modify project files or user settings, does not require startup hooks or ReadyToRun overrides, and requires a full Rider restart after installation, update, disablement, or removal.
